annotations.text:
Editorial dark direction.
The theme toggle and the Web / Mobile tabs are live — click them on the desktop and phone boards.
Desktop opens on the Web tab, the phone board on Mobile, so both states are visible at once.

New section: Mobile apps.
Copy comes from the two repos (README, AGENTS, theme files). The readings on the phone screens (27.4 °C, pH 7.2, recibo 4820) are sample values to show the UI — not real data.

Two things to confirm:
1. Kotlin, Dart, Flutter and Compose are marked Intermediate — your call on the level.
2. Google Play link is left off Vestigra until the listing is public.
